title: Structural Inconsistency and Stability Classification of Multi-symplectic Diamond Schemes
summary: Multi-symplectic diamond schemes proposed by McLachlan and Wilkins (2015) provide a framework for the numerical integration of Hamiltonian partial differential equations, combining local implicitness with high-order accuracy and discrete multi-symplectic conservation laws. Despite these advantages, their behavior beyond a limited class of model equations remains poorly understood, and numerical difficulties may arise depending on the underlying multi-symplectic formulation.
